node.title: Structural Awareness
node.reading:
The whole program in one read — every idea explained, every series and paper linked, so this page works as both a synthesis and an index you can navigate from.

This is the deep version of the front door. It explains the one idea and each discipline, restores the independence test and the falsifiable battery, and ends with a full link map. The throughline under everything is structural awareness — diagnosed, recovered, and detected across human transformation and adaptive systems alike. Browse the whole body of work at the Field Notes hub.

relations: A shared conceptual programme does not make evidence from one research branch a validation of the others.
Afinidad conceptual no crea una teoría unificada validada ni permite sumar evidencias incompatibles.
The four-series programme can supply distinct diagnostic questions for reading JUBAP in the field without treating their convergence as four independent validations of the framework.
La práctica histórica no deriva de publicaciones posteriores; convergencia conceptual y contraste empírico se mantienen separados.
The integrated Foundation separates bounded representation from loss of qualification as conditions change; the two problems interact without being identical.
Es una formulación del corpus y sus hipótesis, no aceptación científica externa.
